title: bag.set
description: One trainer economy (MULTI_GAME_PLAN §4.9, MG6): the ledger's projection into the followed game's save on a region.resume or after a region.start (the server sends it, the client forwards it): the adapter writes save.money and replaces the bag's non-key items with `items` within the game's limits (Gen 1: 20 slots, 99 a stack); what did not fit is answered in act.result{kind:"bag.set", left}; `stamp` is written into the save's mod data and echoed by every bag.sync. Reasons not_ingame, busy, too_many.

items.description: The game's item symbols and quantities to hold (key items untouched).
